purpose: ORG-derived experimental growth of standalone filled rectangles with intact contours, circle keep-out, a hard 1.25x per-axis ceiling, trace-centerline clearance on straight side-by-side interactions, and a source-bound deferred-work log for any permitted corner trace overlap.
eligibility: Standalone filled F.Cu source polygon with exact supported geometry, four unique vertices, adjacent perpendicular edges, and equal opposing sides. The complete 1.25x per-axis growth envelope must fit inside the registered crop; otherwise preserve the whole source shape unchanged. Retain exact source spans and do not infer pad or net identity.
factor_basis: Owner-directed hard 1.25x ceiling on each source-local axis; not a manufacturing sizing rule.
contour_rule: Every proposal remains one complete rectangle in the source-local axes. Original and T01 circle occupancy plus the 0.02002 mm construction gap is protected; neighboring copper may limit either growth axis, but must never carve, recess, notch, or round a rectangular contour.

trace_interactions.side_by_side_rule: For a straight native segment running alongside the central portion of a rectangle side within 15 degrees, keep the complete grown rectangle at least 0.02002 mm from the segment centerline. The trace width is not included in this centerline measurement.
trace_interactions.corner_rule: At non-side-by-side corner interactions, T02 may propose rectangle growth through trace copper. T02 never changes or removes trace geometry. This is experimental; the owner has not supplied a numeric maximum overlap beyond the rectangle's hard 1.25x per-axis ceiling.
trace_interactions.deferred_record: Every positive-area overlap between a T02 rectangle addition and native trace copper is recorded with rectangle and trace source IDs/spans, source geometry hash, overlap area, and overlap-geometry hash in future_trace_work_items.json. This includes side-by-side segments that meet the centerline standoff but whose copper width still intersects the candidate. Disposition is DEFERRED_TO_FUTURE_TRACE_SESSION; trace_changed_in_t02 is false. Report cumulative pairwise overlap area separately from the unique union of T02 additions intersecting the union of trace copper.
trace_interactions.future_trace_scope: A later trace task may review recorded local interactions and decide whether to reroute, bend, narrow, or leave a trace unchanged. T02 makes no such edit, and does not imply every recorded interaction needs adjustment.

scene_update: Deterministic source-center Y, X, then source-identity order. Each proposal sees all original F.Cu except that trace copper is separately classified: side-by-side segments constrain growth by centerline distance; every trace-copper intersection is recorded and deferred without modification. All other source copper, the accepted T01 scene, and earlier T02 additions remain protected.
protected: all ORG F.Cu source contributions other than separately classified traces
the complete accepted T01 scene and its round priorities
accepted T01 square-recess or negative geometry when explicitly represented; otherwise its accepted neighborhood remains no-write protected
limitations: Source graphics do not supply a native pad/net identity or prove a trace-to-land electrical relationship.
The selected crop uses a screenshot locator with at least 0.0223 mm raster uncertainty.
No electrical, native-export, manufacturing, or EDIT-equivalence claim is made.
Straight side-by-side spacing is a centerline standoff, not guaranteed surface clearance. Pairwise overlap area can double-count copper; unique added-copper overlap is reported separately.
The owner has not numerically bounded the word slight for trace overlap; actual overlap magnitudes must be reviewed before this experimental candidate is treated as accepted.
